canonical: Exact ordered fields above; fixed32 raw digests; u16/u64 BE; no NULL/extra; LABEL_VERSION=1. Label identity SHA256(ASCII FLOOOW/P0090/R5N2A/LABEL/V1 || all fields). Resource identity SHA256 retained native object birth/namespace tuple encoded by adapter schema, never name/number alone.
state_transition: ABSENT->PREPARED->COMMITTED; writer10 commits complete tuple + complete resource alias-set digest + predecessor label revision/digest + expected registry tip under CAS; guard8 read-only independently confirms; future adapter exposes one authoritative label identity atomically or denies all aliases. COMMITTED->REVOKED monotonic; UNKNOWN never authorizes.

cases.partial_propagation: No complete resource alias set + committed label identity => NOT_QUALIFIED; invalidate all affected work.
cases.resource_duplication: New alias preserves same resource identity; adapter commits alias-set successor atomically before either alias is usable; unsupported duplicate denied.
cases.resource_transfer: Only explicit allowed owner/channel transition, new subject binding requires fresh prepared label CAS; source loses eligibility before target can commit. Default forbidden.
cases.resource_inheritance: Default deny; only signed bootstrap inventory or approved POSTMASTER engine-child plan; parent binding cannot authorize child use.
cases.resource_aliasing: All names/FD aliases resolving same retained object share one resource identity; path string/fd number alone never identity. Unknown aliases => deny resource.
cases.FD_duplication: Same object alias rule; protected slot descriptors cannot be overwritten.
cases.socket_transfer: SCM_RIGHTS capability transfer default denied; metadata sender PIDFD is temporary observation handle, never promoted to channel/credential resource.
cases.IPC_transfer: Default denied; private engine IPC only within declared subject compartment and approved child plan.
cases.process_fork_spawn: Only POSTMASTER declared engine children; require observed birth tuple, inherited private compartment and complete labels before child gets eligibility. Other ACTIVE participants cannot spawn/exec.
cases.reconnect: Retire old channel label; pending UNKNOWN retained; new channel requires new enrollment and label commit, never reuse old binding.
cases.restart: Old process/credential labels revoked and tombstoned before new generation enrollment; no namespace/PID reuse authority.
cases.crash_before_commit: ABSENT/PREPARED never authorize; incomplete record => UNKNOWN.
cases.crash_after_commit: Recover exact durable committed record plus independent guard observation; no rollback of use/alias revisions.
cases.stale_generation: Reject mismatch against independently current high water; no older signed fallback.
cases.wrong_registry_revision: Reject; reobserve and recommit label for exact current tip before use.
cases.UNKNOWN: No operation/qualification; journal pending state retained, never success by absence.

mandatory_operations: resolve all aliases without user-controlled path traversal escape
adapter_conformance.algorithm: Before granting resource use, capture kernel-retained object identity and complete alias set under adapter synchronization; compare committed label tuple/alias digest/current generation/registry/subject/credential/work to independently approved expected tuple; hold synchronization or operate on retained immutable reference through use. Any uncertain race denies; cannot validate path then reopen by string. Publish conformance receipt only if each case above and each logical operation has proven complete mediation.
adapter_conformance.proof_contract: Future adapter must supply source-to-hook complete mediation proof for every resource class and check/use linearization point, then isolated counterexample tests for every alias/transfer/race/crash case. Missing hook/proof => adapter NOT_CONFORMANT, never weaken IR. No concrete backend absent value is required now.
